title: An unauthorized oil tanker catches fire after hitting a mine east of the Strait of Hormuz
text:
An unauthorized oil tanker catches fire after hitting a mine east of the Strait of Hormuz"

"🔆🔅 Public Relations of the Iranian Army Navy: A few hours ago, an unauthorized oil tanker, having switched off its tracking systems in an attempt to pass through a prohibited and unsafe area east of the Strait of Hormuz, struck naval mines, suffering damage and catching fire."

"🔹 The Strait of Hormuz is unsafe and closed to unauthorized vessels and to craft that intend to transit without coordination. For safe passage, they must make the necessary coordination arrangements with the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran.
